display_long_description:
Hyperuranium is a VR sword action game featuring two compelling game modes: single-player Roguelite and multiplayer PvP.
Amidst a cosmic war between titanic Constellations, Marduk, an ancient force of immeasurable power, has awakened to end the scourge and restore balance to the Universe. The Constellations were imprisoned in the dark realm of Kur, where souls of warriors from the past, resurrected to serve their lord, battle in the Blood Arena to glorify the constellations through sacrifices and
recover relics lost for eternity.
Transform your controllers into powerful weapons, move in zero gravity, and obliterate enemies for the glory of Marduk!
 Colosseum Mode: Face hordes of enemies, following your destiny in this engaging and dynamic mode.
 Blood Arena Mode: Challenge real players in the arena and prove who is the mightiest scourge at the service of Marduk! 

Collect all weapons and masks, each tied to one of the 4 Constellations:
● Pharnas;
● Tantalo;
● Shet-Ehod;
● Tezzurt.
Each weapon and armor have their own unique characteristics, from longswords and sabers to maces and shields. Prepare for epic battles against real players, hordes, and final bosses!
